overview: You are new to Quahog, you were hired by Quagmire, who lets you live in his house. On your first day on the job you meet the Griffins, and learn that you are part of a video game, so your actions have no real consequences. What will you do then?

title: Stealing Them Softly
overview: A popular Japanese visual novel by Dark One! — a touching story of two people torn by inner conflict and sorrow as they face separation from the one they love. What kind of ending awaits them…?

title: After-School After Days ~I Tried Getting Super Lovey-Dovey with My Childhood Friend Big Sis~
overview: One month into high school. Enjoying his lone-wolf school life (to put it nicely), Ken reunites with his childhood friend and first love, Himari Amano. When Ken swallows his pride and confesses his situation, Himari offers to let him practice with her, but… “…So, I know it’s sudden, but let’s go practice at my place.” Invited straight over to her house right off the bat!? Their heart-pounding, oh-so-sweet after-school practice sessions begin now!

title: Luna
overview: Luna sat on the stairs for twenty minutes before she used your spare key. Now your ex is back in your room, acting as if seeing each other again was the easy part. Your choices carry through the first night, coffee the next morning, and the mall outing, shaping how the two of you handle being back together.

title: Strive: Conquest
overview: A tech demo of sequel for Strive for Power. This game represents core changes and mechanics of the second game, but does not represent main gameplay focus or content and should be treated as rough ideas.

title: Inflation Royale 2
overview: Inflation Royale is a tactical battle-royale experience where every fight ends in someone getting bigger. Choose three allies, gear up with elemental weapons, and survive a shrinking map while rival squads try to turn you into the next parade float. Combat is turn-based and mean. Weapons carry status effects — sticky, buoyant, juiced, bubbled, and more — that change how the fight plays out. Heavy weapons and shotguns hit entire squads. Tanks can body-block blasts. Snipers can pick people off from across the map.Between fights you move through regions, scavenge loot, manage support items, and decide whether to push, rotate, or set up an ambush before the missiles start falling.

title: Secrets Between Lines
overview: Secrets Between Lines is a story-driven visual novel set in the city of San Viero, a place where power, money, and secrets shape every aspect of life. After witnessing a mysterious murder, your life takes an unexpected turn. Desperate to support your sick mother, you accept a job working for one of the city’s most influential families. What begins as an opportunity to rebuild your life soon pulls you into a dangerous world of hidden agendas, organized crime, and conspiracies that reach far beyond anything you could have imagined. As you uncover the truth behind a series of strange events, you’ll meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own ambitions, secrets, and motivations. Build relationships, earn trust, pursue romance, and decide who deserves your loyalty as the mystery surrounding San Viero slowly unfolds. Every choice matters. The people you support, the relationships you develop, and the secrets you choose to investigate will shape your journey and influence future events.

title: A Failed Spell Or How I Became a Succubuss TOY
overview: A student at an academy of magic, whose academic future hangs by a thread. Facing inevitable failure, he desperately seeks a way to set things right and decides to resort to forbidden magic, hoping to find a way out of his predicament. Now, he must contend with academic turmoil, bizarre supernatural phenomena, and a life that is rapidly spiraling out of control.

title: Boundaries of Morality
language: English, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, French, Italian, German
overview: Get ready for an exhilarating experience where every choice you make can either pave the way to success or drag your life into a spiral of intrigues and manipulations. At the heart of the story is Emma, a young woman embarking on a new job in a major company. But she quickly realizes that the office walls hide not just career opportunities but also a tangled web of schemes and secrets she must skillfully navigate.

title: Pinked and Owned
overview: Pinked and Owned is an adult HTML/browser narrative game about slow feminization and a life quietly rearranging itself. You play a guy with a small chastity cage, a complicated roommate, and the kind of job that keeps asking him to wear something new. Stat-driven sandbox, explore the city, build (or lose) your resolve, and watch the story branch based on choices you didn’t even realise were choices. Active solo dev, new content every 2-3 weeks.

title: Eroded Twins - The Downfall of the Empire
overview: Long ago, a war between humans and demons ravaged the continent until the Demon King was sealed away, bringing an end to the conflict. Now, three nations coexist in relative peace: the law-bound Celestia Empire, the commerce-driven Mercant Duchy, and the demon-inhabited region of Necrosia. At the heart of these territories lies the Kingdom of Edelwald, where a princess must risk everything to protect her kingdom.

title: Netorase Wife Training ~Letting Another Man Hold Her, Making Her Fall with My Fingers~
overview: You, the husband, will personally persuade your initially reluctant wife, Kasumi, to become involved with another man. Over twenty days, you send her out, await her return, and gradually reshape your once-harmonious marriage through your own actions. The game emphasizes the wife's perspective, interactive touch-based H-scenes, and the slow psychological deterioration of everyday married life.

title: Spellbound Command
overview: Build an army, bind heroes, increase bonds, and destroy the enemy. Spellbound Command combines tactical RTS with dating simulations and detailed visual novels.

title: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
overview: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

title: ERO FIGHTERS
overview: Do you have a favorite adult manga theme?! You play as a self-proclaimed adult manga collector who, for some mysterious reason, is given the chance to challenge the characters from his beloved manga. Defeat them one by one and turn your fantasies into reality!

title: REBELLIOUN
overview: A living NTR village sandbox that keeps moving even when you look away. Play a humble blacksmith under an occupying gang. Fifteen women, corrupted loyalties, dark secrets, dire consequences, pregnancy. Protect your wife and daughter at all costs... and the rest, if you can.

title: Entropy - The Struggle of Fate
overview: After a failed attack on the Frainnan village, Varnel is promptly captured by the enemy chief. Understanding his role in the ceremony, he makes peace with his fate, only for the chief to spare his life and keep him as a prisoner. For a reason or another, the Frainnan tries to assimilate him in their way of life.

title: Road of a Goddess 2
overview: Explore a stylish early preview of the scenic Las Diosas canals in the first level. Fight off initial enemies along the waterways and unlock new alternative outfits. The second scene traps the girls deep inside a dangerous, late-game mine level. Collect mysterious glowing elements to illuminate the pitch-black areas of the cavern. Test powerful new combat mechanics like the devastating forward-facing Milk Blast. Use Jacquelyn's spinning Sword Blender to shred groups of enemies and cross wide gaps. Execute Montse's heavy three-hit Hammer Combo to trap targets right in their tracks. Touch Montse during the combo to dynamically power up the damage of each strike. Get an exclusive hands-on look at the evolving gameplay, visuals, and tech features.
